1.text: Yikira mu bwato arambuka, agera mu mudugudu w'iwabo.

2.text: Bamuzanira ikirema kiryamye mu ngobyi, nuko Yesu abonye kwizera kwabo abwira icyo kirema ati “Mwana wanjye, humura ibyaha byawe urabibabariwe.”

4.text: Ariko Yesu amenya ibyo bibwira arababaza ati “Ni iki kibateye kwibwira ibidatunganye mu mitima yanyu?

5.text: Icyoroshye ni ikihe? Ni ukuvuga nti ‘Ibyaha byawe urabibabariwe’, cyangwa nti ‘Byuka ugende’?

6.text: Ariko mumenye yuko Umwana w'umuntu afite ubutware mu isi, bwo kubabarira abantu ibyaha.” Nuko abwira icyo kirema ati “Byuka wikorere ingobyi yawe utahe.”

8.text: Abantu babibonye baratangara, bahimbaza Imana yahaye abantu ubutware bungana butyo.

9.text: Yesu avayo, akigenda abona umuntu witwaga Matayo yicaye aho yakoresherezaga ikoro, aramubwira ati “Nkurikira.”Arahaguruka, aramukurikira.

10.text: Hanyuma ubwo Yesu yari yicaye mu nzu bafungura, haza abakoresha b'ikoro benshi n'abanyabyaha, basangira na Yesu n'abigishwa be.

11.text: Abafarisayo babibonye babaza abigishwa be bati “Ni iki gitumye umwigisha wanyu asangira n'abakoresha b'ikoro n'abanyabyaha?”

12.text: Abyumvise arababwira ati “Abazima si bo bifuza umuvuzi, keretse abarwayi.

13.text: Ariko nimugende, mwige uko iri jambo risobanurwa ngo ‘Icyo nkunda ni imbabazi, si ibitambo.’ Sinazanywe no guhamagara abakiranuka, keretse abanyabyaha.”

14.text: Maze haza abigishwa ba Yohana baramubaza bati “Ni iki gituma twebwe n'Abafarisayo twiyiriza ubusa kenshi, nyamara abigishwa bawe ntibiyirize ubusa?”

15.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Abasangwa ntibabasha kugira agahinda bakiri kumwe n'umukwe, ariko iminsi izaza, ubwo umukwe azabavanwamo, ni bwo baziyiriza ubusa.

16.text: “Nta wutera ikiremo cy'igitambaro gishya ku mwenda ushaje kuko icyo kiremo cyaca umwenda, umwenge ukarushaho kuba mugari.

17.text: Kandi nta wusuka vino y'umutobe mu mifuka y'impu ishaje, uwagira atyo iyo mifuka yaturika, vino igasandara hasi imifuka ikononekara. Ahubwo vino y'umutobe isukwa mu mifuka mishya, byombi bikarama.”

18.text: Akibabwira ayo magambo, haza umutware aramupfukamira, aramubwira ati “Umukobwa wanjye amaze gupfa, ariko ngwino umurambikeho ikiganza cyawe arahembuka.”

20.text: Nuko hari umugore uri mu mugongo wari abimaranye imyaka cumi n'ibiri, amuturuka inyuma akora ku nshunda z'umwenda we,

21.text: kuko yibwiraga ati “Ninkora umwenda we gusa ndakira.”

22.text: Yesu arahindukira amubonye aramubwira ati “Mwana wanjye, komera. Kwizera kwawe kuragukijije.” Umugore akira uwo mwanya.

23.text: Yesu ageze mu muryango w'inzu y'uwo mutware, abona abavuza imyirongi n'abantu benshi baboroga

24.text: arababwira ati “Nimuhave kuko agakobwa kadapfuye, ahubwo karasinziriye.” Baramuseka cyane.

25.text: Abantu bamaze guhezwa yinjira mu nzu, agafata ukuboko karabyuka.

26.text: Iyo nkuru yamamara muri icyo gihugu cyose.

27.text: Maze Yesu avayo. akigenda impumyi ebyiri ziramukurikira zitaka ziti “Tubabarire mwene Dawidi.”

28.text: Ageze mu nzu izo mpumyi ziramwegera, Yesu arazibaza ati “Mwizeye ko mbishobora?”Ziramusubiza ziti “Yee, Databuja.”

29.text: Aherako akora ku maso yazo arazibwira ati “Bibabere nk'uko mwizeye.”

30.text: Amaso yabo arahumuka, Yesu arabihanangiriza cyane ati “Mwirinde ntihagire umuntu ubimenya.”

31.text: Nyamara basohotse bamwamamaza hose muri icyo gihugu.

32.text: Bakigenda, bamuzanira ikiragi gitewe na dayimoni.

33.text: Amaze kwirukana dayimoni ikiragi kiravuga, abantu baratangara bati “Uhereye kera kose ntihigeze kuboneka nk'ibi muri Isirayeli.”

34.text: Ariko Abafarisayo baravuga bati “Umutware w'abadayimoni ni we umuha kwirukana abadayimoni.”

35.text: Yesu agenda mu midugudu n'ibirorero byose, yigisha mu masinagogi avuga ubutumwa bwiza bw'ubwami, akiza indwara zose n'ubumuga bwose.

36.text: Abonye abantu uko ari benshi arabababarira, kuko bari barushye cyane basandaye nk'intama zitagira umwungeri.

37.text: Maze abwira abigishwa be ati “Ibisarurwa ni byinshi, ariko abasaruzi ni bake.

38.text: Nuko rero mwinginge nyir'ibisarurwa, yohereze abasaruzi mu bisarurwa bye.”
